No pricing option can be put forward from this run because the under‑4% monthly churn limit was not assessable.

- The price comparison itself held up under the changes tested, but that is not evidence that any option meets your churn constraint or the £20k MRR target.
- The model lacks a compatible churn measure, and its MRR target has no stated measurement frame or baseline; its direction was also assumed to be “higher is better”.
- The ordering is most sensitive to the feature-release value assumption, which is an Olumi estimate; the uncertainty around that release’s effect remains material.
